verdict.rationale: VLP's Intellectual Property practice page has a dedicated Trademark and Copyright section. It documents filing and prosecuting domestic and foreign trademark applications, including Madrid Protocol filings, for clients from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, so registration is clearly covered within a defined practice. Missing for 10: any documented trademark clearance or search services, brand enforcement (oppositions, cancellations, infringement or cease-and-desist work), and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As IP counsel, the firm handles trademark clearance, registration, and brand enforcement, documented as its own practice or team

citations.quote: Filing and prosecuting domestic and foreign trademark applications, including International Applications under the Madrid Protocol.
VLP's trademark clients range in size from Fortune 500 companies to early stage start-ups
